children: AmiViz will reaffirm at GISEC Global 2026 its role as one of the Middle East’s most influential cybersecurity orchestrators and continue its commitment to shaping the region’s defence strategies.

From September 16 to 18 at the Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City Dubai, the company will present a powerful showcase of sovereign security architecture, AI-driven threat defence and operational resilience.

These themes reflect a threat landscape that has evolved dramatically, where nation-state activity, AI-enabled attacks and critical-infrastructure targeting have become mainstream. For AmiViz, GISEC is not just an exhibition — it is a signal that the most complex security conversations in MEA happen here, and the company is ready to lead them.

At GISEC, AmiViz will demonstrate what consultative distribution looks like in practice. Rather than showcasing isolated products, the company will present outcomes: sovereign AI deployments, zero-trust architectures and data-resilience frameworks built for the region’s regulatory reality.

The convergence of OT and IT security, the rise of AI-enabled threat actors and increasing pressure on data sovereignty are shaping enterprise risk across the GCC. AmiViz’s approach is architecture-first, not reactive patching, designed specifically for the compliance, operational and geopolitical environment of the Middle East.

Identity-based attacks continue to escalate, with identity now functioning as the region’s most targeted perimeter. AI-generated phishing has made social engineering nearly indistinguishable from legitimate communication, creating new challenges for organisations across government, finance and critical infrastructure. AmiViz’s strategy for 2026 centres on zero-trust identity frameworks, AI-powered threat detection that evolves with attacker behaviour and security awareness embedded into enterprise culture. The company’s focus is on helping organisations build layered, intelligent resilience against threats that move faster than traditional defences.
AmiViz will feature a curated ecosystem of next-generation cybersecurity innovators, each addressing a critical dimension of modern enterprise defence.

Ramkumar Balakrishnan, Chief Executive Officer at AmiViz, said: “This year, we are demonstrating architectures and technologies built for the AI era — solutions that help organisations stay ahead of threats that evolve faster than legacy defences. We look forward to welcoming visitors to our stand and showing how AmiViz and our ecosystem partners are enabling the next stage of cybersecurity resilience across the Middle East.”
